about_short_description.short_description: Arroyo is a serverless stream processing platform to run SQL queries against your real-time data in Kafka.

product.name: Arroyo Streaming Engine
product.description: A cloud-native stream processing platform that runs SQL queries on real-time data streams with sub-second latency, supporting stateful computations and exactly-once processing.

product.name: User-Defined Functions (UDFs)
product.description: A feature allowing users to extend Arroyo SQL with custom logic by writing functions in Rust, enabling parsing of custom data formats and complex computations within streaming queries.

product.name: Arroyo Web UI
product.description: A web-based interface for managing connections, developing and testing SQL queries, and monitoring streaming pipelines in Arroyo.

product.name: REST API for Pipeline Management
product.description: An API that enables declarative creation, operation, and management of streaming pipelines at scale within Arroyo.

product.name: Connectors for Data Integration
product.description: A collection of source and sink connectors enabling Arroyo to integrate with various data systems like Kafka, MQTT, Redis, Delta Lake, and HTTP endpoints.
